description: Daemon invokes one registered plugin operation. Params: operation_id + interface + method (strings resolving to an admitted descriptor) + arguments (object). external_receipt-contract responses are {ok:bool, result:object, child_receipts:array} with NO plugin-authored external_receipt; the daemon injects the receipt
source: BBB_V2_AUDIT.md section 6.4; plugin_invoke_contract.c:408-644; conversation_plugin_dispatch.c (request build); bbb_dispatch.c:398-460; bbb.go:367-424
checked_by: framing round-trip now; contract wrap/validation lands with the Go host worker (step 3)

vectors.name: request
vectors.note: daemon uses string ids for plugin.invoke and caps the rendered frame at 1 MiB before sending

vectors.name: response_plugin_result_before_wrap
vectors.note: what the plugin sends: ok bool + result object + child_receipts array, and it MUST NOT include external_receipt (daemon rejects, plugin_invoke_contract.c:600-601); C dispatch helpers emit exactly this shape (bbb_dispatch.c:254-278)

vectors.name: response_after_daemon_wrap
vectors.note: the daemon injects the host-authored receipt into the plugin's result before crediting it upstream (further receipt fields per plugin_invoke_contract.c:127-150 elided)

vectors.name: response_plugin_failure
vectors.note: failure reason/reason_code are read from inside result.result (plugin_invoke_contract.c:161-199)

vectors.name: response_error_method_not_found
vectors.note: C dispatch shape for an unregistered method (the Go SDK serve loop diverges: -32601 for ANY handler error, no data - audit finding F-2)

vectors.name: invalid_arguments_not_object
vectors.note: the daemon-side contract module refuses to build a service request from this (SEV_ERR_BADARG); a conforming host never emits it

vectors.name: invalid_plugin_response_with_self_authored_receipt
vectors.note: plugin text is data, a host-authored receipt is proof: a self-vouched receipt is rejected outright
